lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in at least four primary longitudinal rows along the visible mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows of spots, forming a grid-like lattice where the high-luminance blobs appear at the intersection points of horizontal and vertical gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity values on the dorsal edge and darker shadow values on the ventral edge.
